title: Simple Naan Bread
description: Soft, yoghurt-based naan breads, oven-baked and brushed with melted reduced-fat spread.

ingredients.text: 10g reduced-fat spread, plus a little extra for greasing

steps: Sift the flour, sugar, salt and baking powder into a large bowl. Make a well in the centre and add the yoghurt. Using your fingertips, gradually draw the flour into the yoghurt, mixing to form a ball of soft dough.
Place the dough on a lightly floured surface and knead well for 5 minutes until the dough forms a smooth ball.
Place the dough in a large lightly greased bowl and cover with cling film.
Place in a warm place for approximately 45 minutes until the dough has increased slightly in size and feels slightly puffy when pressed.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and, using a sharp knife, cut into four equal pieces. If the dough is sticky, dust with a  little more flour.
Form into four oval-shaped balls, then roll out into ovals approximately 11cm x 22cm (roughly 4½in x 9in).
Place the naan bread on two lightly greased baking trays and prick with a fork.
Bake in the preheated oven for 8 minutes or until lightly golden and puffy.
Remove from the baking trays and place on a cooling rack.
Place the reduced-fat spread in a small saucepan over a very low heat.
Heat until just melted, then use to brush over the naan breads.
Serve at once, while still warm. (You can also cool your naan bread
